text: Reason knocks at the door of this house and is gently, permanently turned away. A single grain of sand, some lying like discarded tools, each casting a long precise shadow though no two shadows agree on where the sun is. A man treads water gripping a satchel of gold coins, refusing to let go even as it drags him under, because releasing it would mean admitting the coins feel like the others just by looking - it may even be hiding among its own flock, discoverable without first tracing every shot and every duck wants only to live.
